_about: Machine-readable companion to docs/start-here/INSTALL_SURFACE.md — facts an AI agent can parse before touching a user's machine. INSTALL_SURFACE.md is the authoritative human source; keep this in sync with it. Always confirm against the live repository (install scripts + release notes) before running commands.

daemon.explicit: an explicit port (--http <port> or MOOTX01_HTTP_PORT) binds exactly and fails if busy — never hunts
daemon.auto: --http auto hunts upward from 4242 to the first free port

dashboard.behavior: the built-in default hunts upward from 4200; an explicitly requested port binds exactly and fails if busy

linux.note: x86_64/arm64 archives include the headless Rust moot-mgr dashboard

windows.note: install.ps1 only places the binaries and adds them to PATH; client wiring is the 'mootx01 install' step (same cross-platform CLI and client roster as macOS/Linux), which also registers the Task Scheduler daemon. moot-mgr (dashboard) ships as the headless Rust build; its admin control channel is a named pipe on Windows (a Unix-domain socket on Linux/macOS)

install.download_unix: build from the checked-out source; do not pipe mutable remote installer scripts into a shell
install.download_windows: build from the checked-out source, or use a pinned authenticated release artifact if one is published
install.download_windows_note: Do not evaluate remote PowerShell installer content; authenticate any installer before it runs.
install.download_homebrew: brew install codedaptive/mootx01-ce/mootx01 (tap: codedaptive/homebrew-mootx01-ce; macOS and Linux); then wire clients with: mootx01 install
install.download_macos_pkg: mootx01-<version>-macos-<arch>.pkg from the GitHub release assets (signed and notarized); the post-install setup assistant wires clients
install.local_build: macOS: swift build -c release --package-path apps/aria-mcp-server; Linux: cd apps/aria-mcp-server/rust && cargo build --release

env.MOOTX01_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES: maximum MCP request body in bytes (default 4194304)
env.MOOTX01_MONITORING_POLL_MS: how often the daemon checks if monitoring is enabled, in ms (default 5000)

files_may_modify: AI client MCP configs (per client — see adapters.clients)
local data directory (MOOTX01_DATA_DIR or the platform default)
